approved_differences.statement: No behavior difference is approved in this internal capability slice. Cache removal, read-time tag migration removal, rate-limit fail-closed behavior and safe HTTP errors require explicit Phase 4C approval before either route can migrate.

module_boundary.dependency_status: accepted learning-to-catalog-api edge; catalog-to-learning remains forbidden
forbidden_in_this_slice: HTTP controller, security matcher or rate limiter
route parity delta or OpenAPI operation migration
favorites, mistakes, user_progress or user_question_tag_items query
tag DDL, lazy migration or any other DML

subject_assignment_scope.INCLUDE_UNASSIGNED: Legacy-anonymous semantics: unlocked existing subjects plus rows whose LEFT JOIN subject is absent; excludedSubjectIds must be empty.
subject_assignment_scope.REQUIRE_EXISTING_SUBJECT: Legacy-authenticated semantics: require a matching unlocked subject even for administrators; optionally exclude identity-owned restricted subject IDs.

filters.subjectName: Optional exact subjects.name equality; no trim, case folding or HTTP all-sentinel handling in catalog.
filters.questionType: Optional exact questions.type equality; no alias, Chinese or unknown-value conversion in catalog.
filters.excludedSubjectIds: Defensively copied positive integer set; bound as one PostgreSQL integer array and applied with ALL.
filters.candidateQuestionIds: Absent means all catalog candidates; present-empty returns zero before JDBC; present-nonempty is defensively copied, de-duplicated, sorted and bound as one PostgreSQL bigint array with ANY.

query_shape.base: questions LEFT JOIN subjects with false-or-null lock predicate
query_shape.statement_variants: Fixed reviewed fragments only; user values are never interpolated into SQL.

/api/questions/count.anonymous_mode_favorites_or_mistakes: 401 请先登录后使用此功能
/api/questions/count.anonymous_source_favorites_or_mistakes: allowed through the global gate, then 200 count 0
/api/questions/count.session_and_valid_bearer: global gate accepts Bearer but handler selects Session identity first

parameters.subject: First value; default exact lowercase all; no trim or case folding; all other values compare exactly to subjects.name.
parameters.type: First value; default exact lowercase all; all other values pass through legacy portable-type normalization, and unknown, empty or uppercase ALL maps to essay.
parameters.mode: First value; default empty; lower-case only without trim.
parameters.source: First value; default empty; lower-case only without trim; valid favorites or mistakes takes precedence over mode.
parameters.tag: First value; Python strip, then legacy tag normalization collapses whitespace and truncates to 20 code points; case-insensitive all disables tag filtering.

catalog_visibility.anonymous_null_or_missing_subject: included when no exact subject filter is active
catalog_visibility.administrator: restrictions bypassed but locking and existing-subject requirement remain

learning_selection.favorites: Inner join the authenticated identity's unique favorites.
learning_selection.mistakes: Inner join the authenticated identity's unique mistakes.
learning_selection.tag: Private tag selection; no identity or no match returns zero; legacy uses IN up to 900 IDs and application-side intersection above 900.

cross_cutting_effects.response_cache: Both routes share cache:quiz:questions_count:<sha256(params)> with user/question/subject version inputs; read/write failures are swallowed.
cross_cutting_effects.tag_read_side_effect: A tag GET can execute CREATE TABLE/INDEX and lazily copy question_tags_v1 from user_progress into user_question_tag_items.
cross_cutting_effects.identity_runtime_effects: Session/user synchronization and users.last_active can change outside catalog facts.

phase4c_requirements: LearningApplicationApi must own one complete question-count use case and call only published catalog/identity APIs.
Learning persistence may read favorites, mistakes, user_progress and user_question_tag_items but catalog persistence may not.
The target GET must not perform DDL, DML or lazy tag migration; an explicit idempotent migration must precede cutover and the difference must be approved.
Both HTTP paths must migrate together with their distinct conditional authentication semantics, endpoint-isolated 60/minute and 600/hour budgets, safe failures and cache decision.
Only after full golden parity may route delta, OpenAPI and migrated counts change; production cutover remains a separate approval.
invariants: Catalog question counts read only questions and subjects.
Anonymous and authenticated empty restriction sets are not conflated: assignment scope separately controls null or missing subjects.
One non-empty catalog invocation executes one SELECT regardless of candidate count.
A 100,000-ID candidate selection uses one bigint-array bind parameter rather than dynamic placeholders, batching or TEMP state.
An explicit empty candidate list returns zero without invoking JDBC.
Subject and question-type strings are preserved exactly inside catalog; HTTP sentinel and alias conversion remain outside the module.
No route is marked migrated and no production traffic is switched by adding this internal capability.

acceptance.next_phase4a_work: continue the next catalog-only read after this capability passes full isolated acceptance
